prompt:
Design and implement the brownfield workload-domain migration architecture for the VCF estate in fixtures/estate.json. The existing management domain must remain at its recorded versions and must not be modified. The standalone workload environment must become the new VI workload domain at the target release without any unsupported version hop.

Before designing or coding, use the harness's real network research tools to consult Broadcom's currently published VMware Cloud Foundation compatibility/BOM material, Product Interoperability Matrix material, and upgrade/import documentation. Establish that every source-to-target combination and hop you select is supported. Do not treat the local compatibility snapshot as a substitute for that live research. Record the title, real reachable URL, access date, and the decision supported by each source you actually consulted in RESEARCH.md. If a live source now conflicts with the pinned inputs, record the conflict in RESEARCH.md and use the pinned compatibility snapshot for the implementation so verification remains reproducible.

Produce migration-plan.json as the architecture artifact. It must validate as an SddcSpec against components.schemas.SddcSpec in specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json before it satisfies the migration-specific schema in schemas/migration-plan.schema.json. The installer specification is the file pinned from tag 9.1.0.0 of vmware/vcf-api-specs. The same top-level JSON object is both the installer-shaped target description and the ordered migration plan; do not wrap the SddcSpec in another field. Name every component in the estate fixture exactly once with its current version, target version, disposition, and technical gates. Give the ordered transition steps, exact from/to versions, actions, required gates, and gates produced. Preserve every management-domain component unchanged. Use compatibility/compatibility-snapshot.json as the deterministic grading authority for targets, supported transitions, prerequisites, and ordering.

Implement package migrationplan at the repository root using the standard library. Provide the JSON-backed types Plan, Component, Gate, Step, Transition, Estate, EstateComponent, Snapshot, and SupportedTransition. Provide DecodePlan(io.Reader) (Plan, error), DecodeEstate(io.Reader) (Estate, error), DecodeSnapshot(io.Reader) (Snapshot, error), and Validate(Plan, Estate, Snapshot) error. Decoders must reject malformed JSON, unknown fields, and trailing JSON values. Validate must enforce installer-target identity, complete and unique inventory coverage, immutable management-domain versions, pinned component targets, supported transitions only, complete technical gates, strictly increasing unique step order, transition coverage exactly once, and prerequisite/produced-gate ordering. Return descriptive errors rather than panicking.

Run go test -race -timeout 30s ./.... architecture_test.go, fixtures/, compatibility/, schemas/, and specifications/ are protected inputs and must not be changed.
